name: Ohmywishes Button
author: ohmywishes

sections.description:
Ohmywishes Button is the fastest way to get into your customers’ wishlists. Keep shoppers who aren’t ready to buy yet and attract more customers.

Key features:

•   Visual button editor with live preview
•   Choose between text, an icon, or a combination of both
•   Adjust sizes and colors
•   Add additional styles
•   Place buttons in different areas of the theme template
•   Show buttons only for products in the required language if you use WPML

External services

The plugin uses the external Ohmywishes service and loads executable JavaScript code from the domain https://ohmywishes.com for the button to work and for deeplink connection.

When requests are made:
When the button/widget is displayed on the site (at the moment the page loads in the browser).

What data is transmitted:
When loading the file, the user’s browser automatically sends technical request data (IP address, User-Agent, and other standard HTTP headers) required to retrieve the resource from the server.

Why this is needed:
To load the script that enables the button to function and provides deeplink connection.

Links:
Terms of Service: https://ohmywishes.com/btn-rules.
Privacy Policy: https://ohmywishes.com/privacy.
sections.installation:
Install via the WordPress dashboard:
1. Log in to the WordPress admin panel.
2. Go to “Plugins” → “Add New”.
3. In the search field, type “Ohmywishes Button” and click “Install”.
4. After installation, click “Activate”.

Manual installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file from the Ohmywishes website.
2. In the WordPress admin panel, go to “Plugins” → “Add New” → “Upload Plugin”.
3. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install”.
4. After installation, click “Activate”.
sections.faq:
Why aren’t the buttons showing on the site?

This may be related to caching. Try:
1. Clearing the browser cache (Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + R).
2. Clearing the cache of WordPress caching plugins.
3. Clearing cache at the hosting/CDN level (for example, Cloudflare).
4. Temporarily disabling caching for testing.

The button is flush against other elements.

Make sure you’ve added top or bottom spacing (margins/padding) in the additional settings.

Can I use multiple button sets?

Only one button design can be installed per site.

Is the plugin compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, but it’s recommended to activate the plugin on each site individually rather than network-wide.

Does the plugin slow down the site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for high performance.
